row_grain.casing: one retained official casing row (u9m4-xnh6); the source repeats a casing string in each filing (record_sequence), so a row is a string as reported in one filing

missing_value: CSV empty cell / JSON null for absent numbers, dates or on_top_record. Zero remains zero. String absence is empty string.
date_policy: Only YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00.000 values with a valid calendar date are parsed to YYYY-MM-DD; the original text is always kept in the matching _text column.
unit_policy: Units are cited from the official documents below with their CONFIRMED or INFERRED label; values are shown as reported with no unit, datum or depth conversion.
window: Exact api_no of the selected inventory row (basis inventory_api_no); not limited to the reporting period.

documents.name: wellbore-wba091.pdf
documents.supports: WBA091 well bore database manual (May 20, 2019): casing segment, plug record, elevation and elevation code list

documents.name: form-w2.pdf
documents.supports: Form W-2 Rev. 01/2014: casing record units (in., ft., sacks) and total depth

documents.name: form-w3.pdf
documents.supports: Form W-3 Rev. 08/2019: plug depth units (ft.), sacks per plug, date well plugged

conflicts.C2: cmt_sacks: WBA091 allows cement in sacks, cubic yards or cubic feet; the ODP column names sacks with no measurement code. Nothing is converted.
conflicts.C3: The plugging view's depth_reference and depth_reference_code have no Form W-3 item; their origin is unstated.
conflicts.C4: The W-3 has a calculated and a measured plug top; the ODP keeps only plug_top_depth, and which one it holds is unstated.
conflicts.C5: toc 0.0 may mean surface or not reported; zero is kept as zero.
conflicts.C6: Sentinel-like extremes (for example toc 4000300.0, csg_size 99.625, completion dates to 2070, w3_date from 1893) are kept as published; there is no plausibility rule.
conflicts.C7: The ODP casing description states one row per API per casing string, but the source repeats strings in each filing (record_sequence); the row grain is restated below.

source_row_key.definition: Dataset snapshot plus 1-based raw response ordinal; retained duplicates stay distinct

source_api_id.definition: The selected inventory row's own api_no string (ADR 004 wellbore domain); rows link to this wellbore, never directly to a UIC

wellbore_link_status.definition: matched / none / ambiguous for this dataset's inventory_api_no link, repeated on every row
wellbore_link_status.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. inventory_api_no link status (ADR 004 §2); not a statement about the well.

source_id.definition: Original source id kept as a string
source_id.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. The only observed unique row key; a repeated id is flagged duplicate_source_id and quarantined.

api_no.definition: Original api_no exactly as published; equal to source_api_id by string comparison only
api_no.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Never padded, trimmed or converted. An eight-digit API cannot distinguish sidetracks or recompletions.

record_sequence.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Filing sequence shared by several rows; not a row key; repeats are normal. Meaning UNSTATED by any official source; not chronological in observed data.

on_top_record.definition: true or false only where the source publishes it; otherwise empty
on_top_record.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. True only where the source sets it; absent in source is shown empty and is not false; never derived from sequence or date. Meaning UNSTATED by any official source.

completion_date.definition: completion_date as YYYY-MM-DD when the source value is a valid calendar date at T00:00:00.000; otherwise empty
completion_date.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Which source date this is is not documented (completion, W-2/G-1 or file date; WBA091 p.2-15 lists several). Values are shown as published with no plausibility rule (C6).

completion_date_text.definition: Original completion_date text exactly as published

csg_size.basis: official_document:form-w2.pdf, p.2 item 36 "Casing Size (in.)"; wellbore-wba091.pdf, p.2-21 WB-CAS-INCH
csg_size.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. CONFIRMED unit. Decimal inches as published; the legacy fraction-to-decimal conversion is INFERRED. Extremes such as 99.625 are kept as published (C6).

hole_size.basis: official_document:form-w2.pdf, p.2 item 36 "Hole Size (in.)"; wellbore-wba091.pdf, p.2-22 WB-HOLE-INCH
hole_size.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. CONFIRMED unit. Extremes such as 100.0 are kept as published (C6).

csg_depth.basis: official_document:form-w2.pdf, p.2 item 36 "Setting Depth (ft.)"; wellbore-wba091.pdf, p.2-21 WB-CASING-DEPTH-SET
csg_depth.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. CONFIRMED unit. Depth basis is not stated.

toc.definition: Top of cement as published: "minimum depth up to which cement was circulated" (WBA091 p.2-22)
toc.basis: official_document:wellbore-wba091.pdf, p.2-22 WB-TOP-OF-CEMENT-CASING; form-w2.pdf, p.2 item 36 "Top of Cement" (no unit)
toc.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. CONFIRMED meaning; unit INFERRED from the other form depth columns. Zero kept as zero; whether 0 means surface or not reported is undocumented (C5). Values such as 4000300.0 are kept as published (C6).

multi_stg_depth.definition: Multi-stage cementing tool depth as published
multi_stg_depth.basis: official_document:form-w2.pdf, p.2 item 36 "Multi-Stage Tool Depth (ft.)"; wellbore-wba091.pdf, p.2-21 WB-MLTI-STG-TOOL-DPTH
multi_stg_depth.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. CONFIRMED unit. The source omits empty values, so missing:multi_stg_depth is expected on most rows (accepted).

cmt_sacks.definition: Cement amount for the string as published
cmt_sacks.basis: official_document:form-w2.pdf, p.2 item 36 "Cement Amount (sacks)"; wellbore-wba091.pdf, p.2-21 WB-AMOUNT-OF-CEMENT
cmt_sacks.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. CONFIRMED on the form. WBA091 p.2-22 allows sacks, cubic yards or cubic feet, but the ODP column names sacks with no measurement code; whether legacy records were converted or excluded is not stated (C2).

total_depth_g1w2.definition: Total depth reported on the G-1/W-2 as published
total_depth_g1w2.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. CONFIRMED unit.

depth_reference.units: ft above mean sea level (INFERRED mapping)
depth_reference.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. WBA091 p.2-15 defines the elevation as "MEASUREMENT OF FEET ABOVE MEAN SEA LEVEL OF WELL"; mapping it to this ODP column is INFERRED. No datum conversion and no depth arithmetic. The plugging view's value has no Form W-3 item and its origin is unstated (C3). 9999.0 may be a legacy fill value (C6).

depth_reference_code.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Shown verbatim; meaning undocumented in ODP metadata. GL, DF, KB, RT and GR are CONFIRMED elevation reference points (WBA091 p.2-15); every other code: meaning not stated.

source_snapshot_id.definition: Dataset ID plus raw response SHA256 prefix

w3_date.definition: w3_date as YYYY-MM-DD when the source value is a valid calendar date at T00:00:00.000; otherwise empty
w3_date.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Which source date this is is not documented (Form W-3 item 15 date or the W-3 filed date; WBA091 p.2-41). Values are shown as published with no plausibility rule (C6).

w3_date_text.definition: Original w3_date text exactly as published

plug_top_depth.basis: official_document:form-w3.pdf, p.1 items 24-25 "Calculated Top of Plug (ft.)" / "Measured Top of Plug (if tagged) (ft.)"; wellbore-wba091.pdf, p.2-47
plug_top_depth.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. CONFIRMED unit. The W-3 has a calculated and a measured plug top; the ODP keeps one, and which one is not stated (C4).

plug_bottom_depth.basis: official_document:form-w3.pdf, p.1 item 21 "Depth to Bottom of Tubing or Drill Pipe (ft.)"; wellbore-wba091.pdf, p.2-47 WB-BOTTOM-TUBE-PIPE-DEPTH
plug_bottom_depth.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. CONFIRMED unit; the mapping to this column is INFERRED from the field name.

plug_cmt_sacks.definition: Cement used for this plug as published
plug_cmt_sacks.basis: official_document:form-w3.pdf, p.1 item 22 "Sacks of Cement Used (each plug)"; wellbore-wba091.pdf, p.2-47 WB-NBR-OF-CEMENT-SACKS
plug_cmt_sacks.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. CONFIRMED unit.

total_depth_w3.definition: Total depth reported on the W-3 as published: "maximum depth of the plugged bore" (WBA091 p.2-41)
total_depth_w3.basis: official_document:wellbore-wba091.pdf, p.2-41 WB-PLUG-TOTAL-DEPTH; form-w3.pdf, p.1 "Total Depth" (no unit)
total_depth_w3.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. CONFIRMED meaning; unit INFERRED from the other W-3 depth items. A published zero is kept as zero; the meaning of a zero total depth is not stated by the source.
